ncp_source_rows.title: HAFAR ALBATIN INERT LANDFILL
ncp_source_rows.description:
The project aims to establish an inert landfill facility for construction and demolition waste in Hafar Al Batin.

The global construction and demolition waste management 
market size was $115 billion in 2020. The market is expected 
to reach $542.7 billion in 2028, with a CAGR of 5.1%

Construction and demolition waste accounts for 30% of the 
total waste produced worldwide and is expected to grow at a 
rate of 3.2 billion tons per year until 2025

The main input to the operation comes from the 
Construction and Demolition Treatment facility for 
final disposal.

Hafar Al Batin’s population growth and expansion 
are the main drivers of construction and demolition 
waste generation

The increase in personal income and government 
incentives for homeownership

The Vision 2030 initiative includes the development 
of the infrastructure sector, which is expected to 
lead to an increase in waste generation 
necessitating further waste management solutions
* CAGR
M USD 

Expected Investment size: 1.7M USD*

Plant capacity: 282,585 tons

Expected IRR: 10.3%

Payback period: 6.54 years

GDP Impact: 28M USD

Location (Region): Hafar Al Batin

ncp_source_rows.title: ALBAHA HEALTHCARE WASTE TREATMENT CENTER
ncp_source_rows.description:
The opportunity aims to operate a healthcare waste treatment infrastructure across all AlBaha cluster.

Driven by the Covid-19 health crisis, medical waste has increased to 2.6 
M tons per day worldwide

Healthcare waste management market globally had a revenue of USD 
12.8 bn in 2021. It is expected to be growing at a CAGR of 6.9% during 
the forecast period (2022-2030)

Market dynamics are also driven by the increasing use of reusable 
surgical products and rising awareness programs for medical waste 
management in developed countries

The project would require healthcare waste provided from 
public and private healthcare providers and transported to the 
facilities through waste collection and transfer operators in 
AlBaha Cluster

Expansion and modernization of the healthcare sector are 
increasing the demand for healthcare waste management 
services

Growth in economic and population in KSA and further 
expansion of AlBaha are additional demand drivers and 
are projected to increase in the future

Drive to increase public sector participation and 
competitiveness in the economy are further drivers for 
formulation of the opportunity
* CAGR

ncp_source_rows.title: مستشفيات الأمومة والأطفال
ncp_source_rows.description: الرئيسية استثمر في الأحساء الفرص الاستثمارية مستشفيات الأمومة والأطفال مستشفيات الأمومة والأطفال قطاع الخدمات الصحية حجم السوق معدل النمو: +8% سنويًا السوق المحلي: نمو من 1 مليار دولار (2022) إلى 8.1 مليار (2030) العائد المتوقع من الاستثمار حجم الاستثمار: 300–500 مليون ريال معدل العائد الداخلي : 5%–15% تصميم وبناء وتشغيل وصيانة مستشفى للولادة والأطفال، وتقديم الخدمات في طب الأطفال وأمراض النساء والولادة. الارتباط برؤية 2030 تخصيص الرعاية الصحية: هدف زيادة التخصيص من 25% إلى 35% بحلول 2030. نظام رعاية الطفل والأمومة: تطوير نظام رعاية متخصص حول رعاية الطفل والأمومة. التحول الصحي: التركيز على تحسين جودة الرعاية للحمل والولادة ورعاية الأطفال حديثي الولادة. الممكنات سهولة الحصول على التمويل: تقييم 50 من 100 في مؤشر سهولة الحصول على الائتمان. النظام الصحي المتطور: أكبر ميزانية رعاية صحية في منطقة الشرق الأوسط وشمال أفريقيا (36.7 مليار دولار في 2022). البنية التحتية المتطورة: مؤشر الأداء اللوجستي 3.2 من 5. شبكة مستشفيات موجودة: 25 مستشفى للنساء والولادة/الأطفال عبر المملكة. إعفاء ضريبي: حتى 50% على رواتب الموظفين السعوديين وتكاليف التدريب لمدة 10 سنوات. تغطية صندوق تنمية الموارد البشرية: 30-50% من الرواتب الشهرية للموظفين السعوديين لمدة سنتين. برامج التدريب: برامج التدريب أثناء العمل للمو

ncp_source_rows.title: الخدمات الطبية للمدارس
ncp_source_rows.description: الرئيسية استثمر في الأحساء الفرص الاستثمارية الخدمات الطبية للمدارس الخدمات الطبية للمدارس قطاع التعليم حجم السوق عدد الطلاب في التعليم العالي(2022): 5.8 - 6.2 مليون عدد الطلاب في التعليم العالي(2030): 6.6 - 7.6 مليون الكـــوادر الطبية (2022): 5 آلاف ممرضة الكـــوادر الطبية (2030): 8 آلاف العائد المتوقع من الاستثمار حجم الاستثمار : يختلف حسب نطاق الخدمات معدل العائد الداخلي: + 250% زيادة في الحاجة للكوادر الطبية حتى 2030 تقديم خدمات طبية شاملة داخل المدارس (طلاب، معلمين، كوادر مساندة) تشمل الرعاية الطارئة، متابعة الأمراض المزمنة، التوعية الصحية، والتنسيق مع الأسر لتحسين صحة المجتمع المدرسي. الارتباط برؤية 2030 برنامج التحول الصحي: تعزيز الوقاية والكشف المبكر داخل المدارس. شراكات بين وزارتي الصحة والتعليم عبر مبادرات Healthy Living Program – School (Health Awareness). رفع الوعي الصحي والسلوكيات الإيجابية لدى الطلاب وأسرهم. الممكنات دعم حكومي من وزارة الصحة + وزارة التعليم. برامج ومبادرات وطنية. شركات متخصصة تقدم عيادات متنقلة وخدمات متكاملة داخل المدارس. المواصفات التقنية خدمات أساسية: رعاية طارئة، متابعة الأمراض المزمنة، التثقيف الصحي، مشاركة الأسرة. عيادات مدرسية مُدمجة + عيادات متنقلة حسب الحاجة. حلول تقنية لمتابعة الحالات والتواصل مع الأسر والجهات الصحية. تطويرمركز المنطقة اللوج

ncp_source_rows.title: AL QASSIM INERT LANDFILL
ncp_source_rows.description:
The project aims to establish an inert landfill facility for construction and demolition waste in Al Qassim.

The global construction and demolition waste management 
market size was $115 billion in 2020. The market is expected 
to reach $542.7 billion in 2028, with a CAGR of 5.1%

Construction and demolition waste accounts for 30% of the 
total waste produced worldwide and is expected to grow at a 
rate of 3.2 billion tons per year until 2025

The main input to the operation comes from the 
Construction and Demolition Treatment facility for 
final disposal.

Al Qassim's population growth and expansion are 
the main drivers of construction and demolition 
waste generation

The increase in personal income and government 
incentives for homeownership

The Vision 2030 initiative includes the development 
of the infrastructure sector, which is expected to 
lead to an increase in waste generation 
necessitating further waste management solutions

ncp_source_rows.title: Investing in Sports Facilities in Public Schools – Dammam
ncp_source_rows.description: This opportunity invests in and manages school sports facilities in Dammam. It improves facility quality, encourages sports for everyone, and helps find and develop new talent, supporting the goals of the Quality of Life Program and the Ministry of Sports. Location: Prince Mohammed bin Fahd Education Complex, Dammam, on a 3,000 m² site. The project will build and run football fields, courts, fitness areas, and multi-purpose sports spaces, using land and buildings already provided by the Ministry of Education.

ncp_source_rows.title: المعالجة الأولية للتمور
ncp_source_rows.description: الرئيسية استثمر في الأحساء الفرص الاستثمارية المعالجة الأولية للتمور المعالجة الأولية للتمور قطاع الزراعة ومعالجة الأغذية حجم السوق نمو السوق المحلي: +11% نمو السوق العالمي: +10% العائد المتوقع من الاستثمار حجم الاستثمار : 20 مليون دولار أمريكي معدل العائد الداخلي: 15% الاستحواذ على مزرعة تمور وإنشاء منشأة معالجة أولية بطاقة إنتاجية للاستفادة من الطلب المحلي والدولي على التمور السعودية. الارتباط برؤية 2030 الأمن الغذائي: دعم أهداف الحكومة في تنويع الاقتصاد والأمن الغذائي. التصنيع المحلي: الاستفادة من المدخلات المحلية وفتح آفاق معالجة الأغذية. مكانة المملكة الدينية: الاستفادة من قيمة "صنع في السعودية" كونها حارس الحرمين الشريفين. الممكنات إجمالي الوظائف المتوقعة: ~600 وظيفة. الموقع الاستراتيجي: للتصدير. الدعم الحكومي المتخصص. توفر المواد الخام المحلية. تطويرمركز المنطقة اللوجستية بالأحساء
ncp_source_rows.master_title_ar: المعالجة الأولية للتمور

ncp_source_rows.title: تطوير مراكز الرعاية الصحية الأولية
ncp_source_rows.description: الرئيسية استثمر في الأحساء الفرص الاستثمارية تطوير مراكز الرعاية الصحية الأولية تطوير مراكز الرعاية الصحية الأولية قطاع الخدمات الصحية حجم السوق معدل النمو السنوي: 4.14% سنويًا حجم السوق (2022): 20 مليار ريال سعودي حجم السوق المتوقع (2030): 28 مليار ريال سعودي العائد المتوقع من الاستثمار حجم الاستثمار : 5 - 20 مليون ريال سعودي معدل العائد الداخلي: 10 - 20 % تطوير مراکز الرعایة الصحیة الأولیة الحالیة من خلال تجدید المبانی، تحسین الخدمات، تطویر القوی العاملة وتقدیم الخدمات السریریة. الارتباط برؤية 2030 برنامج التحول الصحي: التركيز على الرعاية المتكاملة والانتقال من الرعاية المستشفوية إلى الرعاية المجتمعية. الوقاية والرعاية المزمنة: الرعاية الأولية محور أساسي في نموذج الرعاية الجديد "البقاء بصحة جيدة" و "الرعاية المزمنة". جودة الخدمات: استهداف 4 زيارات للشخص الواحد سنويًا متماشيًا مع المؤشرات العالمية. الممكنات سهولة الحصول على التمويل. الأجور التنافسية إقليمياً. النظام الصحي المتقدم. البنية التحتية المتطورة. المواصفات التقنية مساحة المنشأة: 1,000-4,000 متر مربع. الطاقة الاستيعابية: 10,000-50,000 زيارة سنوية. تطويرمركز المنطقة اللوجستية بالأحساء

ncp_source_rows.title: مراكز التدريب التقني والمهني في السياحة والضيافة
ncp_source_rows.description: الرئيسية استثمر في الأحساء الفرص الاستثمارية مراكز التدريب التقني والمهني في السياحة والضيافة مراكز التدريب التقني والمهني في السياحة والضيافة قطاع التعليم حجم السوق الزيارات: 100 مليون زيارة بحلول 2023 الإنفاق السياحي (2015): 131 مليار ريال الإنفاق السياحي (2023): 455 مليار ريال حاجة العمالة المتوقعة حتى 2030 : 500-475 الف عامل العائد المتوقع من الاستثمار حجم الاستثمار : 50-40 مليون ريال مساهمة الناتج المحلي: 10-5.3% بحلول 2023 إنشاء وتطوير مراكز تدريب سياحي وفندقي لتأهيل الكوادر الوطنية عبر برامج تعليمية معتمدة دوليا، تلبي احتياجات سوق العمل وتدعم مستهدفات رؤية 2030. الارتباط برؤية 2030 رفع مساهمة السياحة في الناتج المحلي من 5.3% (في 2022) إلى أكثر من 10% بحلول 2030. دعم مشاريع السياحة العملاقة (القدية، البحر الأحمر، العلا، نيوم) من خلال توفير كوادر مؤهلة. تمكين الشباب السعودي عبر التدريب التقني والمهني المعتمد دولياً. جذب الاستثمارات الخاصة بدعم صندوق التنمية السياحية. الممكنات تسهيلات تمويلية من صندوق التنمية السياحية. دعم حكومي مباشر عبر وزارة السياحة،والمؤسسة العامة للتدريب التقني والمهني. تسهيل دخول السياح عبر سياسات التأشيرات. فرص شراكات استراتيجية مع معاهد تدريب عالمية. المواصفات التقنية الطاقة الاستيعابية: 1,000 متدرب لكل مركز. برامج تدريبية معتمدة محليا ودوليا. بنية تحتي

Page Content Riyadh, April 2026 , the Ministry of Municipalities and Housing (MOMAH) and the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), have announced the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) stage for the Municipal Food Safety Labs Operation Project under a PPP framework (Equip-Operate-Maintain-Transfer) for a contract duration of 5 years, inviting local, regional, and global companies with experience in lab operations to participate and submit their bids. The project scope includes equipping, operating, and maintaining food safety labs across five municipalities, including Hafr Al Batin, Northern Borders, Tabuk, Qassim, and Al Ahsa. The project aims to upgrade lab equipment, expand chemical and microbiological testing capacity for food and water products, ensure testing accuracy to support the lab compliance value chain, and facilitate ongoing knowledge transfer and end-of-contract handov

ncp_source_rows.title: MAKKAH INERT LANDFILL
ncp_source_rows.description:
The project aims to establish an inert landfill facility for construction and demolition waste in Makkah.

The global construction and demolition waste management 
market size was $115 billion in 2020. The market is expected 
to reach $542.7 billion in 2028, with a CAGR of 5.1%

Construction and demolition waste accounts for 30% of the 
total waste produced worldwide and is expected to grow at a 
rate of 3.2 billion tons per year until 2025

The main input to the operation comes from the 
Construction and Demolition Treatment facility for 
final disposal.

Makkah's population growth and expansion are the 
main drivers of construction and demolition waste 
generation

The increase in personal income and government 
incentives for homeownership

The Vision 2030 initiative includes the development 
of the infrastructure sector, which is expected to 
lead to an increase in waste generation 
necessitating further waste management solutions
* CAGR
M USD 

Expected Investment size: 9.8M USD*


ncp_source_rows.title: YANBU END OF LIFE TYRES TREATMENT FACILITY
ncp_source_rows.description:
The aim of this opportunity is to create a waste tire treatment facility for the entire Yanbu cluster.

Nearly one billion ELTs are generated worldwide annually, 
constituting more than 2% of the total amount of solid waste, and 
this waste flow is growing dynamically

The operation would require a stable input of end-of-life tires 
from producers for processing the waste

The rise in personal wealth and transforming 
consumer behavior in the Kingdom (increasing 
digitization, increasing personal consumption etc.) 
are increasing tire consumption requiring uplift in 
waste treatment solutions 

Waste management sector transformation driven by 
the Vision 2030 and initiatives to increase private 
sector participation require innovative, and 
sustainable solutions in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA is 
expected to generate significant increase in consumption over the 
coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an end-of-life tire 
treatment facility operator to enter an attractive market

The Kingdom is placing a significant focus on the waste 
management sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project 
can expect high level of engagement

ncp_source_rows.title: AL QUNFUDHAH HEALTHCARE WASTE TREATMENT CENTER
ncp_source_rows.description:
The opportunity aims to operate a healthcare waste treatment infrastructure across all Al Qunfudhah cluster.

Driven by the Covid-19 health crisis, medical waste has 
increased to 2.6 M tons per day worldwide

Healthcare waste management market globally had a revenue 
of USD 12.8 bn in 2021. It is expected to be growing at a 
CAGR of 6.9% during the forecast period (2022-2030)

Market dynamics are also driven by the increasing use of 
reusable surgical products and rising awareness programs for 
medical waste management in developed countries

The project would require healthcare waste provided 
from public and private healthcare providers and 
transported to the facilities through waste collection 
and transfer operators in Al Qunfudhah Cluster

Expansion and modernization of the healthcare 
sector are increasing the demand for healthcare 
waste management services

Growth in economic and population in KSA and 
further expansion of Al Qunfudhah are additional 
demand drivers and are projected to increase in 
the future

Drive to increase public sector participation and 
competitiveness in the economy are further drivers 
for formulation of the opportunity
* CAGR
M USD

ncp_source_rows.title: Dammam END OF LIFE TYRES TREATMENT FACILITY 1
ncp_source_rows.description:
The aim of this opportunity is to create a waste tire treatment facility for the entire Dammam Cluster.

Nearly one billion ELTs are generated worldwide annually, constituting 
more than 2% of the total amount of solid waste, and this waste flow is 
growing dynamically

The operation would require a stable input of end-of-life tires from 
producers for processing and transfer along the further waste treatment 
value chain

The rise in personal wealth and transforming consumer 
behavior in the Kingdom (increasing digitization, increasing 
personal consumption etc.) are increasing tire 
consumption requiring uplift in waste treatment solutions 

Waste management sector transformation driven by the 
Vision 2030 and initiatives to increase private sector 
participation require innovative, and sustainable solutions 
in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA is 
expected to generate significant increase in consumption over the 
coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an end-of-life tire 
treatment facility operator to enter an attractive market

The Kingdom is placing a significant focus on the waste management 
sector as part of the Vision 2030 and

ncp_source_rows.title: AL QUNFUDHAH INERT LANDFILL
ncp_source_rows.description:
The project aims to establish an inert landfill facility for construction and demolition waste in Al Qunfudhah.

The global construction and demolition waste management 
market size was $115 billion in 2020. The market is expected 
to reach $542.7 billion in 2028, with a CAGR of 5.1%

Construction and demolition waste accounts for 30% of the 
total waste produced worldwide and is expected to grow at a 
rate of 3.2 billion tons per year until 2025

The main input to the operation comes from the 
Construction and Demolition Treatment facility for 
final disposal.

Al Qunfudhah's population growth and expansion 
are the main drivers of construction and demolition 
waste generation

The increase in personal income and government 
incentives for homeownership

The Vision 2030 initiative includes the development 
of the infrastructure sector, which is expected to 
lead to an increase in waste generation 
necessitating further waste management solutions
* CAGR
M USD 

Expected Investment size: 2.2M USD*

Plant capacity: 374,838 tons 

Expected IRR: 10.33%

Payback period: 6.54 years

GDP Impact: 37M USD

Location (Region): Al Qunfudhah

ncp_source_rows.title: AL QUNFUDHAH CONSTRUCTION AND DEMOLITION WASTE TREATMENT FACILITY 2
ncp_source_rows.description:
The project is aiming to establish a fixed facility for construction and demolition waste (CDW) treatment, offering services in Al Qunfudhah
 

The global construction and demolition waste 
management market size was $115 billion in 2020. 
The market is expected to reach $542.7 billion in 
2028, with a CAGR of 5.1%

Construction and demolition waste accounts for 30% 
of the total waste produced worldwide and is 
expected to grow at a rate of 3.2 billion tons per year 
until 2025

The opportunity relies on a constant inflow of construction and 
demolition coming from private CDW collectors

Al Qunfudhah's population growth and expansion 
are the main drivers of construction and demolition 
waste generation

The increase in personal income and government 
incentives for homeownership

The Vision 2030 initiative includes the development 
of the infrastructure sector, which is expected to 
lead to an increase in waste generation 
necessitating further waste management solutions
* CAGR


Due to continued growth in KSAs construction sector the 
project is looking to deliver greenfield opportunity in the sector 
with limited existing competition

ncp_source_rows.title: Integrated Potato Play
ncp_source_rows.description: Invest in an integrated potato facility, farming optimal breeds (e.g., Hermes, Spunta, Desiree, Elite, and Super Elite, hybrid) to produce fresh whole potatoes as well as frozen and value-added potato products (e.g., chips)

ncp_source_rows.title: Safe storage in Riyadh
ncp_source_rows.description: A secure storage and high-value goods warehouse in Riyadh, serving luxury retailers, jewelry traders, galleries, e-commerce sellers, and high-value importers. The facility will provide private vaults, safe cages, secure inventory rooms, climate-controlled storage, insured handling, chain-of-custody tracking, packing / dispatch support, and secure pickup / delivery across Riyadh

ncp_source_rows.title: Safe storage in Jeddah
ncp_source_rows.description: A secure storage and high-value goods warehouse in Jeddah, serving luxury retailers, jewelry traders, galleries, e-commerce sellers, and high-value importers. The facility will provide private vaults, safe cages, secure inventory rooms, climate-controlled storage, insured handling, chain-of-custody tracking, packing / dispatch support, and secure pickup / delivery across Jeddah and the Western Region.

ncp_source_rows.title: Development of aircraft spare parts manufacturing industry
ncp_source_rows.description: Establish a KSA-based aircraft spare parts manufacturing and localization platform focused on high-recurring, non-critical and certifiable aircraft components identified from airline Required Spare Parts Lists. The opportunity targets selected parts with recurring fleet demand, high import dependency, and manageable certification requirements, serving Saudi and GCC airlines, MRO operators, and aviation suppliers

ncp_source_rows.title: Relocation of regional hubs for e‑commerce and Courier Express Parcel (CEP)
ncp_source_rows.description: Attract freight forwarders, 3PLs, e-commerce platforms, fulfillment operators, and CEP players to relocate regional logistics hubs to Saudi Arabia, anchored around Riyadh Integrated / SILZ. The opportunity targets bonded warehousing, air-freight transfer, cross-docking, fulfillment, sortation, returns processing, inventory buffering, and GCC distribution

ncp_source_rows.title: Set up a GSE leasing and managed fleet platform for major KSA airports
ncp_source_rows.description: Establish a specialized GSE leasing and managed fleet platform that procures new ground support equipment from OEMs, leases it to ground handlers, airlines, cargo handlers, FBOs and airport operators, and provides maintenance, telematics, spare-unit pooling and eGSE transition support. Selective sale-and-leaseback transactions can be used to secure anchor customers and recycle capital from existing operator-owned fleets

ncp_source_rows.title: Chartered jets and fractional ownership services operator
ncp_source_rows.description: Establish a Saudi-based private aviation operator offering on-demand jet charter, fractional ownership, jet cards, aircraft management, and premium flight support. The opportunity targets corporate executives, UHNWI / HNWI travelers, family offices, major events, luxury tourism destinations, and business delegations across high-growth nodes in the Kingdom

ncp_source_rows.title: Development of aircraft refitting industry
ncp_source_rows.description: Establish a KSA-based aircraft refitting facility offering cabin reconfiguration, avionics modernization, passenger-to-freighter (P2F) conversion support, and VVIP completions, serving Saudi, GCC and wider MENA commercial carriers, cargo operators, lessors, business aviation operators, and government / royal fleets

ncp_source_rows.title: Food security terminal in Yanbu
ncp_source_rows.description: Development of a multi-commodity food security terminal at Yanbu’s Red Sea gateway, combining dry-bulk silos, ambient and temperature-controlled storage, food-grade liquid tanks, QC / inspection facilities, customs-enabled handling, redistribution, and optional re-export for strategic food commodities. The terminal will support grains, rice, sugar, edible oils, feed inputs, chilled / frozen foods, and packaged staples, strengthening Saudi Arabia’s strategic food reserves, import resilience, and western-region food distribution.

ncp_source_rows.title: Attract logistics firms to support the oil and gas industry at SPARK
ncp_source_rows.description: Develop and lease 49,000 sqm of bonded warehouse space at SPARK for oil and gas logistics tenants, including equipment suppliers, spare-parts distributors, maintenance firms, and specialist storage operators. The platform is supported by SPARK’s dry port, customs access, and energy-sector ecosystem, with future upside from tenant-led tank-container, bulk-storage, maintenance, and hazmat BTS facilities

ncp_source_rows.title: Development of marinas to support yachting and leisure vessels in Saudi Arabia
ncp_source_rows.description: Develop a network of modern marinas across Saudi Arabia’s Red Sea and Arabian Gulf coasts, serving premium yachting, leisure boating, chartering, water sports, and coastal tourism. The opportunity will combine marina infrastructure, berthing, dry storage, fuel, utilities, maintenance, F&B/retail, and visitor services to activate coastal destinations and build a scalable marine-tourism ecosystem

ncp_source_rows.title: Development of Jubail freight station
ncp_source_rows.description: Develop a rail-linked freight station in Jubail to serve industrial cargo, port flows, and regional distribution. The facility will combine rail terminal yards, cross-dock, warehousing, truck staging, cargo handling, and value-added logistics services, supporting Jubail’s role as an integrated industrial and logistics hub

ncp_source_rows.title: Expansion of logistics and industrial zones around King Abdullah Port
ncp_source_rows.description: Expansion of port-adjacent logistics and industrial zones around King Abdullah Port within KAEC, positioning the site as a Red Sea resilience platform for bonded warehousing, re-export, light manufacturing, automotive logistics, cold chain, and supply-chain continuity

ncp_source_rows.title: Jadidat Arar Cross-Border Logistics Center
ncp_source_rows.description: A cross-border logistics center at Jadidat Arar serving Saudi–Iraq trade flows, exporters, importers, industrial distributors, food and FMCG suppliers, building-material traders, 3PLs, customs brokers, and regional re-export operators. The center will provide truck staging, customs-ready storage, bonded / controlled warehousing where licensed, cross-docking, inspection areas, value-added services, documentation support, and dispatch to Iraq and Northern Saudi corridors

ncp_source_rows.title: Development of Dammam Regional Logistics Center
ncp_source_rows.description: A large-scale regional logistics center in Dammam serving agriculture / food, chemicals, metals, and building-material flows across Eastern Province, Riyadh, Jubail, and GCC markets. The center will provide bulk and breakbulk yards, general and specialized warehousing, consolidation, customs-ready storage, value-added handling, multimodal transfer, and road / rail dispatch, leveraging Dammam’s port gateway role and future Land Bridge connectivity

ncp_source_rows.title: Micro-Fulfillment Hubs in Riyadh and Jeddah
ncp_source_rows.description: A network of urban micro-fulfillment hubs in Riyadh and Jeddah, designed to support fast-moving e-commerce, grocery, retail, FMCG, pharmacy. The hubs will provide compact Grade-A fulfillment space, ambient and temperature-controlled storage, picking / packing, rider staging, inventory pooling, returns handling, and last-mile dispatch to reduce delivery times and improve service reliability

ncp_source_rows.title: Peri-Urban Distripark in Al-Ahsa
ncp_source_rows.description: A peri-urban distripark in Al Ahsa serving food & beverage, agriculture, agri-inputs, and regional food distribution. The zone will provide cold and dry storage, farm-gate aggregation, sorting, grading, packing, labeling, cross-docking, inventory pooling, and regional dispatch for farms, food processors, wholesalers, retailers, HORECA suppliers, and 3PL operators across Al Ahsa, Eastern Province, Riyadh, and GCC corridors.
ncp_source_rows.master_title_ar: Peri-Urban Distripark in Al-Ahsa

ncp_source_rows.title: Industrial Valley Logistics Lands for Clean Industries in KAEC
ncp_source_rows.description: Serviced industrial and logistics land offerings within KAEC Industrial Valley and SEZ, positioned for clean and light industries such as FMCG, pharmaceuticals, building materials, automotive, packaging, and logistics services. Providing serviced plots through long-term lease or freehold ownership, enabling investor-led development of manufacturing, storage, and distribution facilities near King Abdullah Port

ncp_source_rows.title: Integrated DG & Chemical Logistics Park in Jeddah’s 3rd Industrial City
ncp_source_rows.description: A specialized Chemical & Dangerous Goods logistics park in Jeddah 3rd Industrial City, providing DG-compliant storage, cargo yards, tank / ISO handling, chemical distribution, and export / re-export staging. The park will serve chemical producers, plastics / rubber manufacturers, specialty-material importers, industrial tenants, and DG logistics operators.

ncp_source_rows.title: Integrated DG & Chemical Logistics Park in Dammam’s 3rd Industrial City
ncp_source_rows.description: A specialized logistics park providing DG-compliant storage, tank handling, and chemical distribution for Dammam’s and Jubail’s industrial base. The facility will serve as a secure inland consolidation point for chemical exports and inbound feedstock, enabling safer operations and attracting global DG logistics operators

ncp_source_rows.title: Bonded & Re-Export Logistics Zone in Jeddah’s 3rd Industrial City
ncp_source_rows.description: A dedicated bonded and re-export logistics zone in Jeddah 3rd Industrial City, combining bonded yards, warehouses, staging areas, and value-added logistics services. The zone will serve chemicals, metals, F&B, industrial tenants, importers, exporters, and re-export players, leveraging internal demand from Jeddah 3rd IC tenants and proximity to Jeddah Islamic Port.

ncp_source_rows.title: Bonded & Re-Export Zone in Dammam’s 3rd Industrial City
ncp_source_rows.description: A dedicated bonded and re-export logistics zone in Dammam 3rd Industrial City, supporting importers, exporters, industrial tenants, machinery / MRO players, petrochemical-linked traders, e-commerce distributors, and regional re-export operators. The zone will provide bonded yards, bonded warehousing, customs-linked storage, value-added services, consolidation, and redistribution, leveraging Dammam’s port, rail, industrial, and Gulf connectivity.

ncp_source_rows.title: Agro-Food & Edible Oils Export Cluster in Jeddah’s 3rd Industrial City
ncp_source_rows.description: An integrated agro-food and edible oils export cluster in Jeddah’s 3rd Industrial City, supporting food processors, edible oils / fats producers, packaging players, ingredients suppliers, and export-oriented F&B manufacturers. The cluster will provide processing-ready plots, cold and dry storage, packaging / labeling, quality-control support, export staging, and port-linked logistics to serve domestic, GCC, Red Sea, African, and wider international markets

ncp_source_rows.title: Cold Chain & Food Park in Makkah 2nd Industrial City
ncp_source_rows.description: A temperature‑controlled logistics park supporting food storage, light processing (packing and portioning), and distribution for the Hajj and Umrah ecosystem and retailers in the Western Region, enabling consolidated cold and ambient flows, seasonal surge capacity, reduced spoilage, and lower logistics costs with reliable peak‑period service for catering operators and organized retail chains (modern supermarkets and hypermarkets).

ncp_source_rows.title: Polyhydroxyalkanoates (PHA)
ncp_source_rows.description: Opportunity to develop Polyhydroxyalkanoates (PHA) production facility of ~10 KTA in KSA to cater regional and global demand

ncp_source_rows.title: Adipic Acid
ncp_source_rows.description: Opportunity to develop Adipic Acid production facility of ~150 KTA in KSA to cater regional and global demand

ncp_source_rows.title: YANBU HEALTHCARE WASTE TREATMENT CENTER
ncp_source_rows.description:
The opportunity aims to operate a healthcare waste treatment infrastructure across all Yanbu cluster.

Driven by the Covid-19 health crisis, medical waste has 
increased to 2.6 M tons per day worldwide

Healthcare waste management market globally had a revenue 
of USD 12.8 bn in 2021. It is expected to be growing at a 
CAGR of 6.9% during the forecast period (2022-2030)

Market dynamics are also driven by the increasing use of 
reusable surgical products and rising awareness programs for 
medical waste management in developed countries

The project would require healthcare waste provided 
from public and private healthcare providers and 
transported to the facilities through waste collection 
and transfer operators in Yanbu Cluster

Expansion and modernization of the healthcare 
sector are increasing the demand for healthcare 
waste management services

Growth in economic and population in KSA and 
further expansion of Yanbu are additional demand 
drivers and are projected to increase in the future

Drive to increase public sector participation and 
competitiveness in the economy are further drivers 
for formulation of the opportunity
* CAGR
M USD 


ncp_source_rows.title: TABUK END OF LIFE TYRES TREATMENT
ncp_source_rows.description:
The aim of this opportunity is to create a waste tire treatment facility for the entire Tabuk cluster.

Nearly one billion ELTs are generated worldwide annually, 
constituting more than 2% of the total amount of solid waste, 
and this waste flow is growing dynamically

The operation would require a stable input of end-of-life tires 
from producers for processing the waste

The rise in personal wealth and transforming 
consumer behavior in the Kingdom (increasing 
digitization, increasing personal consumption etc.) 
are increasing tire consumption requiring uplift in 
waste treatment solutions 

Waste management sector transformation driven 
by the Vision 2030 and initiatives to increase 
private sector participation require innovative, and 
sustainable solutions in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA 
is expected to generate significant increase in consumption 
over the coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an 
end-of-life tire treatment facility operator to enter an attractive 
market

The Kingdom is placing a significant focus on the waste 
management sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project 
can expect high level of engagement

ncp_source_rows.title: TAIF HAZARDOUS INDUSTRIAL WASTE TREATMENT
ncp_source_rows.description:
The project aims to establish a treatment center mainly for hazardous industrial waste across Taif cluster.

The global industrial waste management market was valued at 
USD 791.14B in 2020. It is estimated to expand at a CAGR of 
10.4% from 2021 to 2031 

The global industrial waste management market is expected to 
cross the value of USD 2.3 T by the end of 2031

Industrial waste constitutes approximately half of the share of the 
overall waste generated across the globe

The operation would mainly require a continuous input of 
hazardous industrial waste from private waste collectors. This 
opportunity also receives waste from other streams such as 
agricultural, healthcare and ELV waste.
The historic and projected growth in industrial 
sector as part of the KSA transformation 
requires innovative solutions for treatment of 
hazardous industrial waste
The drive to increase private sector 
participation and competitiveness in the 
economy are further drivers for formulation of 
the opportunity
The need to modernize waste management 
sector in the Kingdom is a key driver to 
attracting investors and operators 
* CAGR
M USD 

As KSA continues to expand the industrial sector

ncp_source_rows.title: JAZAN END OF LIFE TYRES TREATMENT FACILITY
ncp_source_rows.description:
The aim of this opportunity is to create a waste tire treatment facility for the entire Jazan cluster.

Nearly one billion ELTs are generated worldwide annually, constituting 
more than 2% of the total amount of solid waste, and this waste flow is 
growing dynamically

The operation would require a stable input of end-of-life tires from 
producers for processing the waste

The rise in personal wealth and transforming consumer 
behavior in the Kingdom (increasing digitization, 
increasing personal consumption etc.) are increasing 
tire consumption requiring uplift in waste treatment 
solutions 

Waste management sector transformation driven by 
the Vision 2030 and initiatives to increase private 
sector participation require innovative, and sustainable 
solutions in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA is 
expected to generate significant increase in consumption over the 
coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an end-of-life tire 
treatment facility operator to enter an attractive market

The Kingdom is placing a significant focus on the waste management 
sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project can expect high level of 
engagement

ncp_source_rows.title: AL JOUF HEALTHCARE WASTE TREATMENT CENTER
ncp_source_rows.description:
The opportunity aims to operate a healthcare waste treatment infrastructure across all Al Jouf cluster.

Driven by the Covid-19 health crisis, medical waste has 
increased to 2.6 M tons per day worldwide

Healthcare waste management market globally had a revenue 
of USD 12.8 bn in 2021. It is expected to be growing at a 
CAGR of 6.9% during the forecast period (2022-2030)

Market dynamics are also driven by the increasing use of 
reusable surgical products and rising awareness programs for 
medical waste management in developed countries

The project would require healthcare waste provided 
from public and private healthcare providers and 
transported to the facilities through waste collection 
and transfer operators in Al Jouf Cluster

Expansion and modernization of the healthcare 
sector are increasing the demand for healthcare 
waste management services

Growth in economic and population in KSA and 
further expansion of Al Jouf are additional 
demand drivers and are projected to increase in

ncp_source_rows.title: JEDDAH INERT LANDFILL
ncp_source_rows.description:
The project aims to establish an inert landfill facility for construction and demolition waste in Jeddah.

The global construction and demolition waste management 
market size was $115 billion in 2020. The market is expected 
to reach $542.7 billion in 2028, with a CAGR of 5.1%

Construction and demolition waste accounts for 30% of the 
total waste produced worldwide and is expected to grow at a 
rate of 3.2 billion tons per year until 2025

The main input to the operation comes from the 
Construction and Demolition Treatment facility for 
final disposal.

Jeddah's population growth and expansion are the 
main drivers of construction and demolition waste 
generation

The increase in personal income and government 
incentives for homeownership

The Vision 2030 initiative includes the development 
of the infrastructure sector, which is expected to 
lead to an increase in waste generation 
necessitating further waste management solutions
* CAGR
M USD 

Expected Investment size: 16.8M USD*

Plant capacity: 2,842,851 tons

Expected IRR: 10.3%

Payback period: 6.54 years

GDP Impact: 280M USD

ncp_source_rows.title: MOMAH and NCP Launch EOI and RFQ for the Rehabilitation Operation and Maintenance of Public Parks PPP Project
ncp_source_rows.description: News Return to Media Center 18/05/2026 Previous Next MOMAH and NCP Launch EOI and RFQ for the Rehabilitation Operation and Maintenance of Public Parks PPP Project Page Image Rehabilitating and operating public parks to enhance quality of life and urban sustainability in line with Vision 2030. Page Content ​ Riyadh, May 2026 – the Ministry of Municipalities and Housing (MOMAH) and the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), are pleased to announce the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) and Request for Qualification (RFQ) phase for a new Public-Private Partnership (PPP) opportunity: Rehabilitation Operation and Maintenance of Public Parks PPP Project. The project covers 50 parks across three regions: Eastern Province, Jeddah, and Madinah. It will be implemented under a Rehabilitate, Operate, Maintain, and Transfer (ROMT) contract with a 15-year duration. ncp_source_rows.title: HAFAR AL BATIN END OF LIFE VEHICLES TREATMENT FACILITY
ncp_source_rows.description:
The aim of this opportunity is to create a waste vehicles treatment facility for the entire Hafar Al Batin cluster.

Global automobile sales began to recover from their pandemic drop, 
reaching 66.7 M units sold in 2021. It is expected to decline in 2022, with 
a 2023 still below 2019

The operation would require a stable input of end-of-life vehicles from 
producers for processing and transfer along the further waste treatment 
value chain

The rise in personal wealth and transforming consumer 
behavior in the Kingdom (increasing digitization, increasing 
personal consumption etc.) are increasing vehicle 
consumption requiring uplift in waste treatment solutions 

Waste management sector transformation driven by the 
Vision 2030 and initiatives to increase private sector 
participation require innovative, and sustainable solutions 
in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA is 
expected to generate significant increase in consumption over the 
coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an end-of-life vehicle 
treatment facility operator to enter an attractive market

ncp_source_rows.title: الخدمات الرقمية للإرشاد والتوجيه المهني
ncp_source_rows.description: الرئيسية استثمر في الأحساء الفرص الاستثمارية الخدمات الرقمية للإرشاد والتوجيه المهني الخدمات الرقمية للإرشاد والتوجيه المهني قطاع التعليم التقنية (EdTech) حجم السوق إجمالي السوق القابل للاستهداف: 2-2.2 مليون مستخدم عدد طلاب التعليم العالي (2030): 1.3-1.5 مليون طالب عدد العاملين (2030): 11-12 مليون شخص نسبة انتشار الإنترنت: 95-100% نسبة التبني الرقمي المدفوع الطلاب: 21-23% العاملين: 15-17% العائد المتوقع من الاستثمار حجم الاستثمار: 40-60 مليون ريال سعودي معدل العائد الداخلي: 11-14% تقريباً تأسيس منصة رقمية شاملة للإرشاد والتوجيه المهني تستهدف الطلاب والمهنيين في المملكة، تقدم خدمات التقييم، الاستشارات، إعداد السيرة الذاتية، والبرامج الإرشادية عبر الإنترنت.تهدف المنصة إلى سد فجوة الإرشاد المهني في السوق المحلي ودعم تطوير رأس المال البشري بما يتماشى مع متطلبات سوق العمل المتغير. الارتباط برؤية 2030 دعم برنامج تنمية القدرات البشرية (HCDP) لتهيئة المواطنين لسوق العمل المحلي والعالمي. مبادرات حكومية مثل سبل (Subol) من صندوق تنمية الموارد البشرية (HRDF) لدعم الإرشاد المهني الرقمي. تعزيز فرص التعلم مدى الحياة وتوفير خدمات الإرشاد للطلاب والباحثين عن عمل. المساهمة في رفع مشاركة المرأة في القوى العاملة، وتحسين المواءمة بين التعليم وسوق العمل. الممكنات دعم حكومي من خلال وزارة التعليم، وزارة ا

ncp_source_rows.title: MAKKAH HEALTHCARE WASTE TREATMENT CENTER
ncp_source_rows.description:
The opportunity aims to operate a healthcare waste treatment infrastructure across all Makkah Cluster.

Driven by the Covid-19 health crisis, medical waste has increased 
to 2.6 M tons per day worldwide

Healthcare waste management market globally had a revenue of 
USD 12.8 bn in 2021. It is expected to be growing at a CAGR of 
6.9% during the forecast period (2022-2030)

Market dynamics are also driven by the increasing use of reusable 
surgical products and rising awareness programs for medical 
waste management in developed countries

The project would require healthcare waste provided 
from public and private healthcare providers and 
transported to the facilities through waste collection and 
transfer operators in Makkah cluster

Expansion and modernization of the healthcare 
sector are increasing the demand for healthcare 
waste management services

Growth in economic and population in KSA and 
further expansion of Makkah are additional 
demand drivers and are projected to increase in 
the future

Drive to increase public sector participation and 
competitiveness in the economy are further 
drivers for formulation of the opportunity
* CAGR
M USD 

Expected Investment

Driven by the Covid-19 health crisis, medical waste has increased to 2.6 
M tons per day worldwide

Healthcare waste management market globally had a revenue of USD 
12.8 bn in 2021. It is expected to be growing at a CAGR of 6.9% during 
the forecast period (2022-2030)

Market dynamics are also driven by the increasing use of reusable 
surgical products and rising awareness programs for medical waste 
management in developed countries

The project would require healthcare waste provided from 
public and private healthcare providers and transported to the 
facilities through waste collection and transfer operators in 
Hafar Al Batin Cluster

Expansion and modernization of the healthcare 
sector are increasing the demand for healthcare 
waste management services

Growth in economic and population in KSA and 
further expansion of Hafar Al Batin are additional 
demand drivers and are projected to increase in the 
future

Drive to increase public sector participation and 
competitiveness in the economy are further drivers 
for formulation of the opportunity

The project aims to establish an inert landfill facility for construction and demolition waste in Asir.

The global construction and demolition waste management 
market size was $115 billion in 2020. The market is expected 
to reach $542.7 billion in 2028, with a CAGR of 5.1%

Construction and demolition waste accounts for 30% of the 
total waste produced worldwide and is expected to grow at a 
rate of 3.2 billion tons per year until 2025

The main input to the operation comes from the 
Construction and Demolition Treatment facility for 
final disposal.

Asir's population growth and expansion are the 
main drivers of construction and demolition 
waste generation

The increase in personal income and 
government incentives for homeownership

The Vision 2030 initiative includes the 
development of the infrastructure sector, which 
is expected to lead to an increase in waste 
generation necessitating further waste 
management solutions

ncp_source_rows.title: Manufacturing Of Circuit Breakers
ncp_source_rows.description: This opportunity entails developing the value chain for the production of circuit breakers to serve KSA and the broader GCC region.The overall demand for circuit breakers in Saudi Arabia has been growing, estimated at USD 370 million in 2018. Driven by utilities, oil and gas and other manufacturing industries, KSA demand is forecasted to increase at an annual growth rate of 4% to reach USD 439 million by 2022. In 2018, demand for circuit breakers is 60% for high voltage and 30% for low voltage and ~10% for medium voltage. The split is expected to remain relatively the same till 2022.Beyond the KSA market, investors in Saudi have the opportunity to tap into the large regional market in the GCC with expected increase in demand from USD 308 million in 2018 to USD 370 million by 2022.The focus of this opportunity is on final manufacturing and components manufacturing of circuit breakers. ncp_source_rows.description: مزايدة تقديم الخدمات الغذائية والعامة ( مطاعم ومتاجر عامة) إضافة "مزايدة تقديم الخدمات الغذائية والعامة ( مطاعم ومتاجر عامة ) بمباني كليات الجامعة". موعد التقديم : يوم الخميس تاريخ 2024/12/19م موعد نهاية تقديم العطاء : يوم الاربعاء تاريخ 2025/01/22م موعد فتح المظاريف : يوم الخميس 2025/01/23م. قيمة الكراسة: 300 ريال     مميزات الفرصة: 1- مدة العقد لمدة ٣ سنوات الشروط تفتح المظاريف الساعة العاشرة والنصف صباحاً بمكتب سعادة مدير عام الإدارة العامة للشؤون الإدارية والمالية بمبنى الإدارة الرئيسي رقم (3) بالدور الثالث. مراجعة إدارة المشتريات والمناقصات للحصول على كراسة الشروط والمواصفات وسداد القيمة عن طريق البنك (نقداً أو شيك مصدق باسم جامعة الملك فيصل). يشترط شراء الكراسة لتقديم العطاء. يشترط تقديم سند الشراء عند تقديم العطاء. شراء الكراسة وتقديم العطاءات يتم عن طريق إدارة المشتريات بمبنى إدارة الجامعة. للاستفسار: يمكن التواصل مع إدارة الاستثمار وتنمية الموارد أو هاتف ( 0135897755 ) للاطلاع على النسخة العامة من كراسة الشروط و المواصفات الرجاء الضغط على الرابط الأسفل :- كراسة الشروط و المواصفات

ncp_source_rows.title: Pomegranate Farm & Experience Center
ncp_source_rows.description: A leading agricultural destination in Al Baha’s fertile highlands, specializing in high-quality, sustainably grown pomegranates—blending traditional farming expertise with modern techniques to deliver a premium local product and immersive farm experience.

ncp_source_rows.title: Strawberry Farm & Visitor Experience Center
ncp_source_rows.description: A modern farm utilizing advanced Controlled Environment Agriculture (CEA) to produce strawberries locally, complemented by a distribution hub and a visitor-friendly F&B outlet—offering seasonal tours and immersive farm experiences.

ncp_source_rows.title: Al Baha Vertical Farming Hub
ncp_source_rows.description: An integrated, vertically structured production and distribution facility leveraging advanced farming technologies to enhance local supply of fruits and vegetables while reducing reliance on imports.

ncp_source_rows.title: Honey Tourism Resort
ncp_source_rows.description: A unique eco-tourism destination inspired by Al Baha’s renowned honey production, offering nature-based stays and interactive experiences that showcase beekeeping culture and honey production.

ncp_source_rows.title: Panoramic Resort in the Sarat Mountains
ncp_source_rows.description: A unique destination set atop the scenic Sarat Mountains, offering luxury stays with breathtaking panoramic views, complemented by cultural experiences and leisure activities—creating a premier retreat for relaxation and nature enjoyment.

ncp_source_rows.title: Mountain Bike Trails Resort
ncp_source_rows.description: A premier adventure and sports destination in Al Baha’s mountains, featuring a network of scenic trails for mountain biking and hiking—offering a unique blend of nature, adventure, and relaxation for outdoor enthusiasts.

ncp_source_rows.title: Al Baha Mountain Resort
ncp_source_rows.description: A luxury mountain destination offering premium stays amid Al Baha’s scenic highlands, featuring panoramic views and a tranquil environment that blends nature, wellness, and refined comfort.

ncp_source_rows.title: Nature Retreat Resort
ncp_source_rows.description: A nature-based resort offering relaxing stays and outdoor adventures, featuring scenic cycling trails set within Al Baha’s stunning landscapes.

ncp_source_rows.title: Al Baha Indoor Snow Center
ncp_source_rows.description: A year-round entertainment destination featuring an indoor ski slope, snow park, ice rink, and dining outlets—offering a unique winter experience in Saudi Arabia and attracting visitors year-round, with strong potential in the growing indoor entertainment sector.

ncp_source_rows.title: Baljurashi Heritage Village
ncp_source_rows.description: A cultural tourism destination that revitalizes traditional life and architecture in Al Baha, offering interactive experiences with handicrafts, heritage markets, and cultural events—enhancing the region’s appeal as a vibrant cultural destination.

ncp_source_rows.title: Al Baha Equestrian Resort
ncp_source_rows.description: A unique equestrian destination in Al Baha offering exciting competitions, horse riding and training programs, entertainment activities, and eco-friendly accommodation experiences.

ncp_source_rows.title: Forest Adventure Resort
ncp_source_rows.description: A unique resort offering immersive nature-based adventures within Al Baha’s dense forests, featuring panoramic views, a mild climate, and year-round outdoor activities in a captivating natural setting.

ncp_source_rows.title: Daws Heritage Village Restoration
ncp_source_rows.description: A cultural destination in Al Baha that revitalizes the historic Daws village, blending heritage with modern amenities to offer a unique experience for visitors interested in history and storytelling.

ncp_source_rows.title: Forest Cabins & Treehouse Retreat
ncp_source_rows.description: A premium eco-adventure destination featuring wooden cabins, treehouses, and treetop trails, offering family-friendly activities within Al Baha’s natural landscapes—positioned for strong growth and sustainable returns driven by rising eco-tourism demand.

ncp_source_rows.title: Cultural & Heritage Palace
ncp_source_rows.description: An immersive cultural destination that showcases the rich heritage and identity of Al Baha. The project offers interactive exhibitions, live traditional crafts, community-driven cultural programs, and authentic heritage hospitality experiences.

ncp_source_rows.title: Luxury Glamping Resort in Al Baha

ncp_source_rows.title: Railway spare parts manufacturing and localization

ncp_source_rows.title: YANBU INERT LANDFILL
ncp_source_rows.description:
The project aims to establish an inert landfill facility for construction and demolition waste in Yanbu.

The global construction and demolition waste management 
market size was $115 billion in 2020. The market is expected 
to reach $542.7 billion in 2028, with a CAGR of 5.1%

Construction and demolition waste accounts for 30% of the 
total waste produced worldwide and is expected to grow at a 
rate of 3.2 billion tons per year until 2025

The main input to the operation comes from the 
Construction and Demolition Treatment facility for 
final disposal.

Yanbu's population growth and expansion are the 
main drivers of construction and demolition waste 
generation

The increase in personal income and government 
incentives for homeownership

The Vision 2030 initiative includes the development 
of the infrastructure sector, which is expected to 
lead to an increase in waste generation 
necessitating further waste management solutions
* CAGR
M USD 

Expected Investment size: 1.7M USD*

Plant capacity: 295,291 tons

Expected IRR: 10.3%

Payback period: 6.54 years

GDP Impact: 29M USD

ncp_source_rows.title: Compound Feed Manufacturing
ncp_source_rows.description: Al-Jouf is one of the most important agricultural and livestock regions in Saudi Arabia, producing large quantities of grains and green fodder alongside livestock. These resources provide an ideal base for establishing a factory to produce various types of compound feed (for cattle, poultry, sheep, camels, and fish). The project aims to meet growing local […]

ncp_source_rows.title: Bakery Products Factory
ncp_source_rows.description: The project aims to supply institutional sectors and retailers with fresh or packaged bakery products of high quality produced according to strict food safety standards using automated production lines that ensure consistent quality and stable daily supply. The project contributes to reducing waste and improving operational margins for institutional consumers such as hotels, restaurants, hospitals, […]

ncp_source_rows.title: Natural Juice Production from Al-Jouf Resources and Juice Concentrates
ncp_source_rows.description: This opportunity aims to establish an integrated factory for producing fresh and packaged juices and fruit concentrates using the latest extraction, packaging, and preservation technologies to ensure products retain their nutritional value and natural flavor. The project includes multiple production lines for natural juices, concentrates, preservative-free beverages, and packaged drinks in glass or carton containers, […]

ncp_source_rows.title: Fruit and Vegetable Processing and Preservation
ncp_source_rows.description: This opportunity aims to establish an industrial complex for processing and preserving fruits and vegetables using modern technologies to ensure product quality and extend shelf life, while developing diverse marketing channels including local markets, retail stores, and national and international supply chains. With increasing seasonal production, there is a growing need for integrated industrial projects […]

ncp_source_rows.title: Primary Date Processing Plant
ncp_source_rows.description: Saudi Arabia is one of the largest date producers in the world, with production exceeding 1.6 million tons annually. This opportunity aims to establish a primary date processing plant with a production capacity of up to 15,000 tons annually to meet local and global demand for Saudi dates and achieve added value through washing, sorting, […]

ncp_source_rows.title: Chilled and Processed Meat Factory in Al-Jouf
ncp_source_rows.description: The project aims to develop advanced capabilities in meat processing and product manufacturing within an integrated cold chain that starts from receiving, through processing and packaging, to distribution, with strict adherence to safety and quality standards. The project enables the production of fresh and chilled local alternatives with consistent quality to meet the needs of […]

ncp_source_rows.title: Dairy Products (Milk, Cheese, Yogurt)
ncp_source_rows.description: An opportunity to establish an integrated factory for producing and processing dairy products using modern technologies to ensure high quality and product safety. The project includes producing a variety of products such as pasteurized milk, yogurt, white and cooked cheeses, cream, butter, and powdered milk to meet local and regional market needs.

ncp_source_rows.title: Primary Poultry Processing
ncp_source_rows.description: Establishing and operating poultry farms and primary processing facilities (slaughtering, cleaning, cooling) to meet growing local demand for poultry meat and eggs and reduce reliance on imports.

ncp_source_rows.title: أنشاء وتشغيل و صيانة القطعة رقم 50/1 ت لنشاط صناعات خفيفة و متوسطة أو ورشة بالمخطط رقم 1082/4 بمصانع الطابوق والخرسانه

ncp_source_rows.title: Electronic and Electrical Wires and Cables Manufacturing
ncp_source_rows.sector: Electronic and Electrical Wire and Cable Manufacturing
ncp_source_rows.description: The project aims to produce low- and medium-voltage cables to serve residential and industrial projects, enhancing self-sufficiency and establishing a strong local electrical industry. It also opens opportunities for regional exports.

ncp_source_rows.title: Electrical Lighting Equipment Manufacturing (Decorative and Outdoor Lighting)
ncp_source_rows.description: The project aims to produce energy-efficient lighting solutions for residential, commercial, and industrial facilities. It supports Saudi Arabia’s drive toward energy efficiency and provides locally manufactured products with global specifications for outdoor lighting, street lighting, and decorative requirements.

ncp_source_rows.title: انشاء وتشغيل وصيانة مبنى تجاري (متعدد الأنشطة) للقطعة رقم 78 د جنوب مدينة الهفوف بحي القدس

ncp_source_rows.title: Home Appliances Assembly (Large, Medium, and Small)
ncp_source_rows.description: The project aims to assemble electrical appliances such as washing machines, refrigerators, and air conditioners, reducing imports and increasing local content. It also provides opportunities for technology transfer and the development of local talent in the electronics manufacturing sector. The project includes assembling small household appliances to meet local market needs at competitive prices, diversifying […]

ncp_source_rows.title: Wooden and Plastic Pallets Production (Shipping Pallets)
ncp_source_rows.description: The project aims to localize the manufacturing of high-quality wooden pallets used in storage, transportation, and export, in compliance with internationally approved loading and safety standards. The project meets growing demand from industrial and commercial companies and distribution centers in Al-Jouf and surrounding areas by providing durable products capable of withstanding heavy loads and repeated […]

ncp_source_rows.title: Jewelry and Gold Accessories Manufacturing (Imitation and Luxury)
ncp_source_rows.description: The project aims to localize the production of high-quality imitation jewelry with modern and innovative designs that compete with global products, using durable materials and precise finishes that give the product a luxurious appearance at an affordable price. The project focuses on meeting the needs of the local retail sector for premium accessories, with dedicated […]

ncp_source_rows.title: Luxury Jewelry and Gift Boxes Manufacturing
ncp_source_rows.description: The project aims to localize the manufacturing of luxury packaging boxes for jewelry, gifts, and high-value products using premium materials and elegant designs that add marketing and aesthetic value to local products. ncp_source_rows.title: Plastic Pipes and Agricultural Products Factory (Irrigation Pipes, Shade Nets)
ncp_source_rows.description: The project aims to localize the production of irrigation pipes and fittings (PE/PVC), agricultural hoses, and shade nets to reduce agricultural input costs and improve water use efficiency. The project contributes to import substitution and expands smart farming solutions by providing ready-made products suitable for farmers’ needs in Al-Jouf and surrounding areas.

ncp_source_rows.title: Plastic and Rubber Waste Recycling Plant
ncp_source_rows.description: Establishing a factory to recycle plastic and rubber waste (HDPE, LDPE, PET) and convert it into recycled pellets used in plastic and agricultural industries. The factory serves the local market and enhances the sustainability of supply chains in the Al-Jouf region.

ncp_source_rows.title: Women’s Abaya or Men’s Ghutra and Thobe Factory
ncp_source_rows.description: The project aims to localize the production of traditional Saudi clothing using modern manufacturing techniques that ensure high quality while preserving authenticity and cultural identity. The project focuses on producing a diverse range of products, including men’s thobes, abayas, shemaghs, and traditional garments, with contemporary designs that meet the needs of various segments. It also […]

ncp_source_rows.title: Solar Energy Battery Production Plant
ncp_source_rows.description: The project aims to localize the manufacturing of renewable energy storage batteries to support the expansion of solar energy projects and hybrid systems within the Kingdom, enhancing energy security and grid stability. The project focuses on producing high-efficiency storage solutions, including lithium batteries and stationary storage systems used in solar plants and residential and industrial […]

ncp_source_rows.title: Development of Flat Glass and Solar Glass Industry
ncp_source_rows.description: The project aims to utilize local natural resources to manufacture value-added products, including clear and tempered glass, double-glazed insulating glass, façade glass for modern buildings, and photovoltaic glass for solar energy. The project contributes to strengthening supply chains for the construction and renewable energy sectors, reducing imports, and increasing Saudi Arabia’s competitiveness in this advanced […]

ncp_source_rows.title: Solar Panel Assembly Plant
ncp_source_rows.description: Establishing a factory to assemble solar panels to meet local and regional demand, supported by Saudi Arabia’s plans to reach 40 GW of solar energy by 2030, with a high annual growth rate of 55%–60% locally. Project objectives include supporting the Kingdom’s renewable energy transition, meeting growing demand for solar panels in local and regional […]

ncp_source_rows.title: Regular and Specialized Paints (Decorative, Resistant, Automotive)
ncp_source_rows.description: The project aims to localize the production of various types of paints—architectural, industrial, and automotive—using advanced production technologies that ensure high quality and technical properties suitable for professional use. The project supports construction, contracting, and manufacturing sectors, reduces reliance on imports, and enhances the local market’s ability to provide products that meet international standards. It […]

ncp_source_rows.title: Industrial Paint and Coating Factory (Powder Coating)
ncp_source_rows.description: Establishing a factory to produce powder coating used for metal finishing, serving the local market in the construction and industrial sectors. Project objectives include meeting local demand for high-quality industrial and architectural paints, providing diverse products including liquid and powder coatings, reducing reliance on imports, and supporting metal industries and the contracting sector with products […]

ncp_source_rows.title: Perfume and Essential Oils Production
ncp_source_rows.description: The project aims to localize the manufacturing of perfumes, essential oils, and fragrance compounds to serve retail and private-label brands, utilizing aromatic plant ingredients and local packaging. The result is reduced imports, accelerated innovation in formulations, and enabling manufacturing contracts for local and regional brands.

ncp_source_rows.title: Soap, Detergents, and Personal Hygiene Products Factory
ncp_source_rows.description: This opportunity aims to localize the production of household detergents, soap, and personal care products in Al-Jouf according to the highest approved standards, with the possibility of manufacturing private-label brands for retail and institutional sectors. The project contributes to import substitution and increasing reliance on local products, stabilizing prices, and providing diverse products near consumption […]

ncp_source_rows.title: Fertilizer Plant (Nitrogen and Potassium Phosphate NPK)
ncp_source_rows.description: Establishing a medium-sized factory to produce nitrogen and phosphate fertilizers (NPK), serving the needs of farmers in Al-Jouf and supporting national agricultural projects. The factory will focus on producing compound fertilizers that are water-soluble and suitable for local agricultural lands.

ncp_source_rows.title: Agricultural Pesticides Factory
ncp_source_rows.description: Establishing a factory to produce agricultural pesticides (liquid, powder, and granules) used to protect crops from pests, focusing on products that comply with environmental and food safety requirements. The project serves farmers in Al-Jouf and agricultural sectors across the Kingdom.

ncp_source_rows.title: Tissue Paper, Sanitary Pads, and Baby Diapers Manufacturing
ncp_source_rows.description: Establishing an integrated factory for producing tissue paper, sanitary pads, and baby diapers in Al-Jouf to meet local and regional demand, leveraging the availability of raw paper materials and easy access to local markets in northern Saudi Arabia. The project scope includes producing a variety of products such as kitchen towels, bathroom tissues, feminine pads, […]

ncp_source_rows.title: Medical Supplies Factory (Textile and Plastic)
ncp_source_rows.description: The project aims to localize the production of consumable medical supplies such as masks, covers, plastic gloves, gowns, and test kits, following approved sterilization and medical packaging standards to ensure safe use. The project contributes to strengthening health security, reducing reliance on imports and their fluctuations, and enabling the provision of reliable products for hospitals, […]

ncp_source_rows.title: Veterinary Medicines and Preparations Factory
ncp_source_rows.description: The project aims to localize the manufacturing of veterinary preparations, including liquids, powders, ointments, and inactivated vaccines when needed, in accordance with GMP standards to ensure product quality and safety. The project supports the livestock sector by providing local preventive and therapeutic treatments, reducing farm and pasture costs, and enhancing the availability of veterinary pharmaceutical […]

ncp_source_rows.title: Personal Safety Equipment and Protective Gear Factory
ncp_source_rows.description: The project aims to localize the manufacturing of personal protective equipment and industrial safety gear used in factories and construction and service projects, including helmets, gloves, safety goggles, safety shoes, and specialized protective tools. Production will adhere to high standards to ensure compliance with occupational safety requirements and regulations approved in the Kingdom. The project […]

ncp_source_rows.title: Plastic and Polymer Furniture
ncp_source_rows.description: The project aims to localize the production of high-durability plastic furniture resistant to weather conditions and suitable for indoor and outdoor use, relying on advanced molding technologies that meet quality and safety standards. The project helps meet the growing demand in the local market, especially in hospitality, rest areas, schools, and parks, in addition to […]

ncp_source_rows.title: Glass Furniture
ncp_source_rows.description: The project aims to localize the manufacturing of high-quality glass furniture using advanced techniques in cutting, shaping, bonding, and printing to produce products characterized by durability, aesthetics, and high precision. The project supports the interior decoration industry by providing innovative solutions, including tables, shelves, glass partitions, and decorative elements used in homes, offices, and stores. […]

ncp_source_rows.title: Metal and Aluminum Furniture
ncp_source_rows.description: The project aims to localize the manufacturing of metal and aluminum furniture for homes, offices, and commercial establishments through advanced production lines that provide high-quality products with durability and strength. The project contributes to gradually replacing imports of this type of furniture, offering local options at competitive prices and specifications that meet market requirements. It […]

ncp_source_rows.title: Wooden Furniture Factory
ncp_source_rows.description: This opportunity aims to establish an integrated factory to produce porcelain and sanitary ware products, including washbasins, toilets, bathroom sets, wall and floor tiles, and bathroom accessories, to meet local market needs and reduce reliance on imports. The project also supports local supply chains and localizes the production of high-quality finishing materials.

ncp_source_rows.title: Gypsum Board Production Plant for Decorations
ncp_source_rows.description: The project targets the production of high-quality gypsum boards used in interior decorations and ceilings to meet the growing demand in the construction sector. It also promotes industrial localization and provides competitive local alternatives.

ncp_source_rows.title: Porcelain and Sanitary Ware Products Plant
ncp_source_rows.sector: Building Products & Porcelain and Sanitary Ware
ncp_source_rows.description: This opportunity aims to establish an integrated factory to produce porcelain and sanitary ware products, including washbasins, toilets, bathroom sets, wall and floor tiles, and bathroom accessories, to meet local market needs and reduce reliance on imports. The project also supports local supply chains and localizes the production of high-quality finishing materials.

ncp_source_rows.title: Clay Brick and Structural Tiles Plant
ncp_source_rows.description: Establishing a plant to produce clay bricks (red) and structural tiles to meet local demand in the residential and commercial construction sector in Al-Jouf and neighboring regions. The plant relies on fired clay in specialized kilns and is considered a medium-sized construction industry.

ncp_source_rows.title: Prefabricated Metal Structures and Sheets Plant
ncp_source_rows.description: Establishing a specialized plant for manufacturing prefabricated metal structures and sheets, including steel pipes, bridges, hangars, warehouses, and pre-engineered buildings. The plant serves the needs of the construction, infrastructure, and industrial projects in Al-Jouf and surrounding areas.

ncp_source_rows.title: Ready-Mix Concrete Plant
ncp_source_rows.description: The project aims to provide high-quality ready-mix concrete to meet the growing needs of construction and housing projects in the Al-Jouf region, focusing on improving supply reliability and reducing transportation costs to execution sites. The project contributes to accelerating construction pace and improving the quality of construction works, supporting the contracting sector and enhancing the […]

ncp_source_rows.title: Specialized Cement Plant (White, Salt-Resistant, or Heat-Resistant)
ncp_source_rows.description: The project aims to localize the production of specialized cement types used in advanced industrial projects and major infrastructure works, such as sulfate-resistant cement, low-heat cement, and high-strength cement. This approach strengthens local supply chains, reduces reliance on imports, and ensures the availability of high-quality products that meet the technical requirements of national projects. It […]

ncp_source_rows.description: This opportunity invests in and manages school sports facilities in Jeddah. It improves facility quality, encourages sports for everyone, and helps find and develop new talent, supporting the goals of the Quality of Life Program and the Ministry of Sports. Location: 6th Elementary Model School, Jeddah, on a 1,250 m² site. The project will build and run football fields, courts, and fitness areas, using land and buildings already provided by the Ministry of Education.

ncp_source_rows.title: Equestrian Training Academy in Public Schools – Riyadh
ncp_source_rows.description: This opportunity sets up an Equestrian Training Academy inside public schools in the Riyadh region. It will build and run riding arenas, stables, and training programs for 250–400 trainees each year. Location: Al Iskan district, Riyadh city, on a site of more than 12,000 m², using land and buildings already provided by the Ministry of Education. It is the first academy of its kind inside a public school, helping promote horse riding as part of Saudi heritage.

ncp_source_rows.description:
The project aims to establish a treatment center mainly for hazardous industrial waste across Hail Cluster.

The global industrial waste management market was valued at USD 
791.14B in 2020. It is estimated to expand at a CAGR of 10.4% from 
2021 to 2031 

The global industrial waste management market is expected to cross the 
value of USD 2.3 T by the end of 2031

Industrial waste constitutes approximately half of the share of the overall 
waste generated across the globe

The operation would mainly require a continuous input of hazardous 
industrial waste from private waste collectors. This opportunity also 
receives waste from other streams such as agricultural, healthcare 
and ELV waste.
The historic and projected growth in industrial sector as 
part of the KSA transformation requires innovative solutions 
for treatment of hazardous industrial waste
The drive to increase private sector participation and 
competitiveness in the economy are further drivers for 
formulation of the opportunity
The need to modernize waste management sector in the 
Kingdom is a key driver to attracting investors and 
operators

ncp_source_rows.title: YANBU END OF LIFE VEHICLES TREATMENT FACILITY
ncp_source_rows.description:
The aim of this opportunity is to create a waste vehicles treatment facility for the entire Yanbu cluster.

Global automobile sales began to recover from their pandemic 
drop, reaching 66.7 M units sold in 2021. It is expected to 
decline in 2022, with a 2023 still below 2019

The operation would require a stable input of end-of-life 
vehicles from producers for processing and transfer along the 
further waste treatment value chain

The rise in personal wealth and transforming 
consumer behavior in the Kingdom (increasing 
digitization, increasing personal consumption etc.) 
are increasing vehicle consumption requiring uplift 
in waste treatment solutions 

Waste management sector transformation driven 
by the Vision 2030 and initiatives to increase 
private sector participation require innovative, and 
sustainable solutions in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA 
is expected to generate significant increase in consumption 
over the coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an 
end-of-life vehicle treatment facility operator to enter an 
attractive market
